items.title: Free MSP Monthly Security Report Template
items.rationale: High-intent MSP query; useful as a standalone free asset and now strengthened by a local JSON-to-Markdown/HTML generator. Competition exists but the template-plus-generator bundle is more defensible than static content alone.
items.next_action: Use as the first free publishing candidate once an approved no-spend channel is available; highlight the local generator as the primary automation differentiator.

items.title: NIS2 Readiness Checklist for MSP Clients
items.rationale: Strong compliance demand and useful MSP discovery angle. Kept evidence-only with prominent disclaimer to avoid legal advice, applicability claims, and geographic overclaiming.
items.next_action: Use as second local publish candidate after the MSP monthly report; highlight the evidence-summary generator as a safe automation differentiator while keeping operational/evidence-only framing.

items.title: M365 Secure Score Executive Report Template
items.rationale: Very automation-friendly because inputs are structured; strong MSP executive-reporting use case and direct bridge to a local JSON-to-report generator. Must avoid implying Microsoft affiliation or complete security assurance.
items.next_action: Use the local generator and sample output as a differentiator on the landing page and repository README.

items.title: Cyber Insurance Evidence Checklist for MSPs
items.rationale: High business urgency around renewals/applications and a natural MSP evidence-collection workflow. The new local questionnaire-to-gap-register generator increases automation defensibility while preserving evidence-only insurance/legal/brokerage disclaimers and no coverage claims.
items.next_action: Use the gap-register generator as the second automation hook after M365; consider adding it to the cyber-insurance landing page copy before public release.

items.title: vCISO QBR Agenda Template for MSPs
items.rationale: Lower direct search volume than compliance/insurance assets but highly reusable for MSP operators and low risk if framed as an operational meeting template rather than professional advice. Useful bridge to a future QBR report generator or MSP governance template pack.
items.next_action: Package with the MSP monthly security report as a governance/reporting bundle; highlight the QBR summary generator as a safe proof-of-value path while ensuring no professional-service, credential, audit, or client-specific risk-acceptance claims.

ranking_note: First asset to publish should still be the MSP monthly security report landing page, now strengthened with its own local generator and sample output. The cyber-insurance evidence checklist remains second by total score because it combines time-sensitive renewal/application search intent with a local gap-register generator. NIS2 remains a strong evidence-only checklist, M365 remains a strong automation differentiator, and vCISO QBR completes the reporting/governance bundle.
